title: Sheafification commutes with the inverse image in the almost cocontinuous case
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a continuous and almost cocontinuous functor and a presheaf whose values at sheaf theoretically empty objects are singletons, sheafifying the inverse image gives the same result as applying the inverse image to the sheafification (statement lines 10196-10204). The proof is a complete computation: the assertion is reduced to comparing the plus constructions, since the plus construction preserves the hypothesis (proof lines 10207-10212); both sides are written as colimits over coverings of the image and of the object (proof lines 10213-10226); and the comparison of the two colimits uses the hypothesis on values at sheaf theoretically empty objects together with almost cocontinuity, which lets any covering of the image be refined by the image of a covering of the object (proof lines 10227-10243). The non-formal content is the comparison of the two colimits. The claim is H2: a structured computation with each input named.
